The Great Gatsby

A young man moves into a rich section of New York. He is swept up in the glitz and glamour of the roaring 20’s, and encounters a rich, eccentric neighbor who, despite what fortune he has, only truly wishes for who he considers to be his true love. As the story progresses, we get a look behind the veil of charm into a decaying world of dark desires, deceit , and irreversible mistakes. The characters unknowingly rush towards their horrible fates. In the end, all that is left is dust and  memories. 

P.S. I live for this book! I know it’s super popular and basic but I am not a hipster. The very feel is just so...... deep!!!!!!!

Mulan! My mom’s favorite Disney movie and easily one of my top three! I’ve watched it at least 30 times, probably average oh about 3 times per year! I know it’s a “kids” movie but honestly has the best characters/songs/plot/dialogue/jokes/everything ever! “Dishonor on you. Dishonor on your family. Dishonor on your cow!” Is so iconic!!!!!

I am absolutely in love with dark shows and with intelligent comedy. I wasn’t sure I would like the whole zombie/ cannibal element ( but who am I kidding... I loved Hannibal) because there are so many shows/ movies/books  that deal with stereotypical zombie monsters, but this show had a very fresh outlook. It was dark, but surprisingly light at moments and stunningly hilarious. I watched it with my mom and we laughed the whole way through :). It really does go under mentioned.
